reconstruction_summary: Re-ran V1 (KS recalibrated with canonical L + per-segment gyro-bias removal from straight-regime samples) by importing the agent's `triage.ks_yaw_rate`, `triage.regime_mask`, and `parameters.PARAM_BY_PLATFORM`; bias fitted per segment as mean(pred - meas) over straight samples.
notes: Agent labels V1 (`0.01469`, bolded) as best in their variant ladder; V2/V3 regress overall. Agent only trained/reported on Mach-E (315 segments); applied identically to Lightning (230 segments) using Lightning's canonical L=3.70 m. Per-segment bias is fit on each segment's straight samples (|delta|<0.01) and subtracted from the KS prediction. Baseline_rmse_recomputed matches the canonical V0 to <1e-6.
